home.title: GENESIS LAB
home.subtitle: Expert-Level Genetic Diagnostics in Baku
home.description: GENESIS LAB is a modern laboratory complex specializing in high-throughput Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) technology. We shorten the path from uncertainty to accurate diagnosis, providing clinicians with evidence-based information.

seo.keywords: genetic diagnostics, NGS, GENESIS LAB, Baku, genetic testing, oncogenetics

access.title: Direct Access
access.description: We have created an advanced technology center in Baku to provide Azerbaijani doctors with direct access to world-class genetic tests. There is no longer a need to send biological materials abroad.

technology.title: Technological Leadership
technology.description: Our laboratory is equipped with FastSeq 300, the most modern NGS sequencer. This device provides exceptional accuracy and high reading speed in DNA and RNA analysis.

location.title: Fully Equipped Laboratory in Baku
location.description: Performing analyses in Baku eliminates the risks of transporting biological materials and guarantees results in the shortest possible time.

expertise.title: Professional Expertise
expertise.description: Our team consists of certified medical geneticists and bioinformaticians. Each identified variant undergoes multi-level verification.

support.title: 360° Support System
support.description: We provide full support at all stages, both for doctors (proper panel selection) and patients (post-analytical consultation).

reports.title: Expert Reports
reports.description: You receive not just a mutation list, but a clinical report that is clear to clinicians, enriched with practical recommendations.

oncogenetics.title: Oncogenetics: Precision Approach in Cancer Treatment
oncogenetics.description: Modern oncology cannot be imagined without molecular profiling. GENESIS LAB focuses on two main areas in oncogenetics:

hereditary.title: Hereditary Oncological Syndromes
hereditary.description: Detection of germinal mutations (e.g., BRCA1/2, Lynch syndrome (MLH1, MSH2, etc.)) provides:
points: Determination of the patient's lifetime individual cancer risk
Selection of radical prevention strategies for the patient and their relatives

somatic.title: Somatic Tumor Profiling (Liquid and Tissue Biopsy)
somatic.description: Analysis of mutations in tumor tissue through the FastSeq 300 sequencer:
points: Targeted Therapy: Selection of drugs that block specific oncogene drivers (EGFR, ALK, ROS1, BRAF, etc.)
Resistance Assessment: Identification of tumor escape mechanisms from treatment
Minimal Residual Disease (MRD) Monitoring: Detection of relapse at the molecular level before clinical signs (CT/MRI)

tests.title: Tests We Offer
tests.description: GENESIS LAB offers a wide range of genetic tests:

nipt.title: NIPT Tests
nipt.description: Non-invasive prenatal tests (NIPT) - modern method to determine the genetic condition of the child from the pregnant woman's blood:

basic1.title: NIPT Basic 1
basic1.description: Trisomy 21 and sex determination. (Suitable for twin pregnancies).

basic2.title: NIPT Basic 2
basic2.description: Most common trisomies (21, 18, 13) and sex determination. (Suitable for twin pregnancies).

standard.title: NIPT Standard
standard.description: Trisomies + 6 sex chromosome aneuploidies + 19 other autosomal aneuploidies.

plus.title: NIPT Plus
plus.description: Standard package + 60 microdeletion and duplication syndromes.

pro.title: NIPT Pro
pro.description: Maximum control! Standard package + 90 microdeletions (including DiGeorge syndrome).

advantage.cnv: Determination of gene copy number variants
advantage.mtdna: Analysis of mitochondrial genome with 5% heteroplasmy

clinical.fastseq: Detection of mosaicism and rare tumor clones
clinical.cnv: Search for large deletions and duplications missed by conventional PCR
clinical.intronic: Detection of hidden mutations that disrupt splicing

partnership.title: Partnership with Doctors
partnership.description: GENESIS LAB is not just a laboratory, it is your intellectual partner. We offer:
points: Consultative assistance in interpreting complex clinical cases
Fast results: Thanks to our local base and the power of FastSeq 300, waiting time is minimized
International Standards: Complete classification of variants according to ACMG/AMP criteria
partnership.tagline: GENESIS LAB: Accurate code — correct decision.
